camera_calibration_toolbox.core.camera_calibration.calculate_fov(afov, working_distance)[source]

Calculate the size of the field of view.

Parameters

  • afov (Tuple[float, float]) – The angular field of view as (horizontal, vertical).

  • working_distance (float) – The distance between the camera and object.

Return type

Tuple[float, float]

Returns
